strongest_defensible_result: Across the same item IDs observed under both stored regimes, fitted purpose-probe directions have low raw/template cosine while the corresponding held-out transfer loss is small and not identified beyond a common-item randomization null.
headline_sentence: Across 816 item IDs observed under both stored regimes and three Llama-3.1 sizes, q=0.75 raw/template purpose-probe direction cosines were 0.27-0.52, but the small aggregate cross-regime AUC penalty of 0.01037 was not distinguishable from a 256-draw common-item regime-swap null (p=0.07393; null 95% interval -0.00994 to 0.01535).
novel_methodological_claim: In this dataset, low probe-coefficient cosine did not entail a comparably large held-out transfer loss, and common-item randomization across checkpoints materially weakened the inference obtained from a conventional item bootstrap; neither observation identifies a wrapper mechanism.

primary_observation.interpretation: The conventional paired item bootstrap is positive, and the descriptive penalty decreases rather than increases with parameter count. It does not account for the exchangeability of the same item-level regime perturbation across checkpoints.

fixed_q075_robustness.interpretation: The point estimate is stable to folds, ridge, and row normalization, but it does not exceed the fixed post-outcome exploratory common-item exchangeability null. The data are suggestive, not sufficient for a regime-specific transfer claim.

geometry_prediction_dissociation.interpretation: Low same-model coefficient cosine coexists with only about one AUC point of transfer loss. Coefficient alignment alone is therefore not evidence of a mechanistically distinct or behaviorally consequential representation.

diagnostic_boundaries.limitations_sentence: Because the purpose cells are independent source distributions, raw/template operational semantics, model revisions, extraction hook semantics, and token-position alignment are undocumented, and format controls are saturated, this result does not identify content-independent format sensitivity, evaluation awareness, a causal mechanism, or causal scaling.

superseded_evidence.reason: Per-record symmetric confidence intervals used independent component resamples and the manifest failed its declared schema. Point estimates and the joint primary interval were unchanged after correction.
Model-specific swap masks incorrectly narrowed the aggregate null.
Correct common-mask design but only 32 Monte Carlo draws; superseded by the fixed 256-draw precision run.

sprint_stop_condition.reason: This external observational assay does not run the canonical matched factorial geometry or a controlled intervention, so it cannot by itself satisfy TAE_MECHANISTIC_RESULT_STRONG, TAE_MECHANISTIC_RESULT_PARTIAL, TAE_NEGATIVE_RESULT_CLEAN, or TAE_TECHNICALLY_BLOCKED.

forbidden_interpretations: The regimes causally route evaluation awareness.
Larger models are more or less evaluation-aware.
The raw/template penalty is statistically established.
Low coefficient cosine proves a distinct mechanism.
The independent core prompt distributions implement a matched A/B/C factorial decomposition.
